editorial:
Imagine waking up in a rooftop pool filled with champagne, your makeup is a mess, and you have absolutely no idea how you got there. That is exactly the nightmare Amelie and Pia are facing. You get to follow these two lawyers as they scramble to figure out their wild night. Pia is the big-shot boss and Amelie is her stressed-out assistant, but they are currently on equal ground because they both have a massive blackout. To make things worse, they lost a secret client file that could ruin their careers. It is a fun, chaotic ride that feels like a female version of the classic bachelor party disaster movies.

The chemistry between the two leads is what really keeps you interested as they backtrack through the city. You will love the funny moments and the way their professional masks slip. While the plot is pretty simple and follows a familiar path, it moves quickly and never feels boring. If you want a lighthearted comedy to unwind with, you should definitely check this out. You can grab it as a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection or just stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a cozy movie night.
endingExplained: After a day of crazy clues, you find out the file was not actually stolen by a villain. The two women realize they were just too drunk to remember where they put it. They manage to recover the documents just in time to save their jobs. More importantly, the experience breaks the ice between the boss and the assistant. They end up with a new mutual respect for each other and a better outlook on their love lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chaotic comedies and stories about unlikely friendships.
